grand_strategy.reading: Monaco is a sovereign city-state whose security is French by treaty and whose wealth rests on a banking and residence model that both the EU and the FATF want to supervise more closely. Its strategy is defensive and rule-bound: keep the French guarantee, refuse the EU terms that would open its residence rules, and pay the reputational cost of the grey list with reforms and checkpoints. Ocean diplomacy and the Prince's humanitarian gestures are the soft instruments it can afford, not substitutes for protection.

stances.note: Treaty ally: the 2002 treaty (in force 1 Dec 2005) gives France the defence of Monaco's independence and sovereignty and binds Monaco's external acts to French fundamental interests. The state visit of 7-8 June 2025 reaffirmed the community of destiny and produced an ocean declaration. No source in the atlas records a dispute with France over the treaty. Bond - affinity: language, the shared border and close administrative ties, with no kinship claim.

stances.note: Transactional neighbourliness without alignment: Italy is Monaco's leading customer and supplier, with more than a fifth of Monegasque trade (Italian ambassador, 2025), and the two foreign ministers met in Monaco in February 2025. Partner rather than ally, because no treaty binds the two.

stances.note: Review 2026-10-12: regraded from partner to neutral (cooling): Monaco applies the EU sanctions since March 2022 and has frozen Russian assets, so the relationship is neither a partnership nor a structural opposition; the Russian residents are a legacy, not an alignment. No source uses the word partner: the grade is our reading of the structure (confidence C), as in the Kosovo card. Monaco keeps diplomatic relations, but since March 2022 it follows the EU blacklist of sanctioned Russians and freezes their assets; the minister of state said the number of Monegasque-targeted nationals stays confidential and that seizures were under consideration. The exposure is the Russian residents of the Principality. Trend cooling is the sanctions, not a rupture. Bond - none.
